name: production-dashboard-ui-ux
description: Production dashboard UI/UX design, audit, redesign, branding, accessibility, performance, responsive behavior, and RTL/LTR workflows.

interface.longDescription: Design, audit, improve, and redesign production dashboards and operational product interfaces. Improve this product's palette, typography, logo treatment, themes, and responsive behavior.
